title: 第五章 第四天灾
content_zh:
牛马管理讨论组。
这是一个只有四人的小群。
群主白驹过隙，群员是隔壁群的三个牛马——换而言之就是狗管理：少女公敌夜十次、八级大狂风、来日方长。
夜十：【你们都收到头盔了？？？】
老白：【收到了……挺邪乎的这玩意儿，直接扔到了我家门口。】
方长：【我是在车库门口发现的……】
狂风：【我是在办公桌上……我还以为是哪个同事的。】
夜十：【你们都没我邪乎，这包裹直接送到了我寝室！我三室友都在，没一个看见这玩意儿是怎么送进来的！而且最邪乎的不知道你们发现没，戴上头盔能看到一个倒计时，但其他人啥也看不到。】
群里诡异的安静了一会儿。
最先打破沉默的，是群主白驹过隙。
老白：【……你这么一说，确实有点儿邪乎。】
方长：【你们说到底是啥游戏公司这么神通广大，不但知道咱地址，还能神不知鬼不觉地把包裹送到咱手上？】
狂风：【嗯，这也是最让我在意的。地址还好说，用点击链接的IP地址的话，分析出我们在现实中的位置，理论上也不是不行。但物流……我想不明白。我在金陵，夜十我记得是在江城读书，这中间差了五百公里，但我们几乎是同时发现收到了头盔。】
夜十：【是……而且就在点击链接之后不久。】
老白：【草，要报警吗？】
方长：【没有财产损失，警察估计也很难办，而且问题是你和警察说啥呢？快递送错了？头盔有问题？除了本人使用，其他人戴上什么也看不见。】
狂风：【嗯，这是最大问题，很难和其他人讲清楚这东西到底是什么。我之前还试了下，戴上头盔的同时将手机也塞了进去，但我明明能看到的东西，手机却什么也拍不到。】
狂风现实中是老师，教的大概是理科，说话比较有条理，这话也得到了方长和老白的一致认同。
夜十：【要不……咱们把头盔拆了看看？】
狂风：【这么做不是不行，但有风险。至少我没有找到可以拆卸的地方，如果暴力拆卸，很难保证还能将头盔装回去。】

方长：【确实，咱也不能坑了阿光。】
能神通广大的将这头盔放在他家车库的门口，他已经有点儿相信那个ID叫光的老哥说的话了。
说不准这家公司是某个受到国家机关支持的神秘研究机构？
不管是什么，总归就目前来看，他们并没有蒙受任何损失。而且他本人对于完全沉浸式的VR游戏，也挺感兴趣的。
那个倒计时，成功的勾起了他的兴趣。
狂风：【我在企鹅上私聊了光哥，但人还没回我消息。那个官网的
夜十：【暗网？！】
狂风：【不清楚。】
老白：【这事儿就先这样吧，讨论也没啥意义。总归等到三天后，咱就能确认这头盔到底是个什么情况了！】
就在玩家们讨论着的时候，身在废土的楚光还在忙碌地做着最后的准备。
5公斤的青麦和一些铁质工具。
楚光费了好些功夫才将这些东西，在不引人注意的情况下从贝特街搬到了三公里外的湿地公园。
404号避难所就藏在这座公园的地下，入口在一座其貌不扬的疗养院内。
这里的植被繁多，而且还靠着湖，理论上应该有不少野生动物在这片区域活动。
靠近这里之后楚光便非常小心，提防着周围可能存在的危险。
不过所幸的是，意外并没有发生。
检查了在疗养院门口做的标记，确认没有异种或者掠夺者趁他不在的时候溜进去，楚光伸出手中带尖儿的水管顶开了门，小心地走了进去。
404号避难所的入口在疗养院大厅最内侧的那台电梯，也只有那台电梯的表盘上写着B1层的标识。
楚光先是下去了一趟，将粮食扔在了电梯底座与缓冲室外侧气闸门之间的走廊。
这里是一片空地，距离地表大概四五十米的样子。

老实说这里不是很适合存放粮食，但放在这里总好过放在疗养院，被路过的老鼠或者变异蟑螂盯上。
穿过缓冲室的两道气闸门。
走进大厅的楚光，看着蹲在墙角的小柒说道。
“官网的论坛功能开发出来了吗？”
“已经搞定了。”
“玩家们呢？他们的头盔收到了吗？”
“已经收到了喔。”
这么快？
楚光略微惊讶。
他记得自己是上午六点离开的避难所，现在也才下午一点左右，中间只隔了七个小时。
“废土这边的时间和现代社会的时间真的是1：1流动吗？”
“当然是，不过这边的时间相当于地球上的西四时区。”
现世那边的华国是东八时区，和西四时区的时差大概是十二小时，也就是说华国东部地区现在正是凌晨一点。
楚光坐在了电脑前，登陆官网后台。
小柒按照他的吩咐，为官网添加了论坛功能，不过目前没有流量，自然是一个帖子都没有。
资料库和图鉴也是一样。
“我该怎么把这边的照片上传到这里？”楚光指着屏幕中的图库说道。
“直接上传就可以了喔。”
“……我的意思就是，我该怎么拍照。或者说你又照相机之类的东西吗？”
这么大个避难所，整个B1层毛都没有就很离谱。

不说留些武器给自己，基本的求生工具总得准备一些吧？
“呃，大概没有相机，不过我的摄像头可以帮您拍照……你想拍哪种？就在这里吗？”
看着墙角废纸篓一样的机器人，楚光叹了口气说道。
“在这儿拍有个鬼用……算了，我自己想想办法。”
总不能把异种捉到这里。
不过，把小柒弄到外面去倒是可以考虑下。
大多数异种对不能吃的铁疙瘩都不咋感兴趣，稍微伪装一下当眼插在楼顶，简直是看家神器啊！
楚光越想越觉得靠谱。
通过居民大厅的电脑登上企鹅号。
楚光发现四个玩家都给自己发了私聊消息，向他打听他任职的到底是哪家公司、完全沉浸式的游戏到底是什么意思、以及游戏头盔究竟是怎么回事儿。
老实说，楚光也不知道该怎么回答他们这些问题，也不可能将这个世界的真实情况讲给他们。
只有让他们相信这里是游戏世界。
他们才能以“第四天灾”的身份降临，无所畏惧且任劳任怨，成为他最强的工具。
“主人。”
“怎么了。”
看着关掉电脑、从椅子前站起身的楚光，蹲在墙角的小柒好奇问道。
“不用回复他们的消息吗？”
“没那个必要。”
解释越多破绽越多，不如一句企业机密、国家机密糊弄过去。
至于其他的？

让他们自己猜去好了。
要不脑袋长来是干什么用的？
不就是用来脑补的么。
content_en:
Cattle and Horse Management Discussion Group.
It was a small group of only four people.
The leader of the group has passed away, and the group members are three cows and horses from the group next door - in other words, dog management: Public Enemy of Girls Night Ten Times, Level 8 Strong Winds, and the Day is Long.
Ye Shi: [Have you all received your helmets? ? ? 】
Lao Bai: [I got it... This is a very evil thing, and it was thrown directly at my door. 】
Fang Chang: [I found it at the garage door...]
Kuang Feng: [I was at my desk... I thought it belonged to a colleague. 】
Ye Shi: [You are not as evil as me, this package was delivered directly to my dormitory! My three roommates were all here, and none of them saw how this thing was delivered! And the weirdest thing, I don’t know if you have noticed it, is that when you put on the helmet, you can see a countdown, but others can’t see anything. 】
The group was eerily quiet for a while.
The first person to break the silence was the group leader.
Lao Bai: [...When you say that, it is indeed a bit evil. 】
Fang Chang: [What kind of game company do you think is so powerful? Not only does it know my address, but it can also deliver the package to me without anyone noticing? 】
Kuangfeng: [Well, this is what worries me the most. The address is okay. If we use the IP address of the clicked link to analyze our location in reality, it is not impossible in theory. But the logistics...I can't figure it out. I was in Jinling, and I remember I was studying in Jiangcheng. There was a difference of 500 kilometers, but we found out that we had received the helmet almost at the same time. 】
Ye Shi: [Yes...and not long after clicking the link. 】
Lao Bai: [Hey, do you want to call the police? 】
Fang Chang: [If there is no property damage, it will probably be difficult for the police to deal with it. And the question is, what do you say to the police? The courier delivered the wrong item? Have a problem with your helmet? Except for my own use, no one else can see anything when wearing it. 】
Kuangfeng: [Well, this is the biggest problem. It’s hard to explain to others what this thing is. I tried it before, putting on the helmet and stuffing my phone into it at the same time, but even though I could clearly see things, my phone couldn't capture anything. 】
In reality, Bang Feng is a teacher, and he probably teaches science. He speaks in a more organized manner, which Fang Chang and Lao Bai agree with.
Ye Shi: [How about... let's take the helmet apart and take a look? 】
Kuangfeng: [It's not impossible to do this, but it's risky. At least I didn't find a place where it can be disassembled. If it is disassembled violently, it is difficult to guarantee that the helmet can be put back on. 】
Fang Chang: [Indeed, we can’t cheat A Guang. 】
Being able to place this helmet at the door of his garage with great powers, he already somewhat believed what the old man with the ID name Guang said.
Could it be that this company is a mysterious research institution supported by state agencies?
No matter what it is, as of now, they have not suffered any losses. And he himself is also very interested in fully immersive VR games.
That countdown successfully aroused his interest.
Kuangfeng: [I privately chatted with Brother Guang on Penguin, but he hasn’t replied to my message yet. That official website
Ye Shi: [Darknet? ! 】
Kuangfeng: [Unclear. 】
Lao Bai: [Let’s just leave it like this for now, there’s no point in discussing it. After all, after three days, we can confirm what the condition of this helmet is! 】
While the players were discussing, Chu Guang, who was in the wasteland, was still busy making final preparations.
5kg of green wheat and some iron tools.
Chu Guang spent a lot of effort to move these things from Beit Street to the Wetland Park three kilometers away without attracting attention.
Shelter No. 404 is hidden underground in this park, and the entrance is in an unassuming sanatorium.
There is a lot of vegetation here, and it is also close to the lake. In theory, there should be many wild animals living in this area.
After approaching here, Chu Guang became very careful, watching out for possible dangers around him.dangers that may exist.
Fortunately, the accident did not happen.
After checking the mark on the door of the nursing home to make sure that no aliens or predators had slipped in while he was away, Chu Guang stretched out the pointed water pipe in his hand to push open the door and walked in carefully.
The entrance to Shelter No. 404 is in the elevator at the innermost side of the sanatorium lobby, and only that elevator has the B1 floor logo written on the dial.
Chu Guang went down first and threw the food in the corridor between the elevator base and the airlock door outside the buffer room.
This is an open space, about forty or fifty meters from the surface.
To be honest, this place is not very suitable for storing food, but it is better than putting it in a nursing home and being stared at by passing rats or mutated cockroaches.
Two airlock doors leading through the buffer chamber.
Chu Guang walked into the hall and looked at Xiao Qi squatting in the corner and said.
“Has the forum function of the official website been developed?”
"It's done."
"Where are the players? Have they received their helmets?"
"Already received."
So fast?
Chu Guang was slightly surprised.
He remembered that he left the shelter at six in the morning, and it was only around one in the afternoon, with only seven hours in between.
"Does the time here in the wasteland and the time in modern society really flow at a 1:1 ratio?"
"Of course it is, but the time here is equivalent to the Western Time Zone on Earth."
The country of China in the current world is in the East 8th time zone, and the time difference from the West 4th time zone is about twelve hours, which means that it is one o'clock in the morning in the eastern part of China.
Chu Guang sat in front of the computer and logged into the backend of the official website.
Xiaoqi followed his instructions and added a forum function to the official website. However, there is currently no traffic, so naturally there is not a single post.
The same goes for databases and illustrations.
"How should I upload the photos here?" Chu Guang said, pointing to the gallery on the screen.
"Just upload it directly."
"...I mean, how should I take pictures? Or do you have a camera or something like that?"
For such a large shelter, it would be outrageous to not have the entire B1 layer of hair.
Not to mention keeping some weapons for yourself, you have to prepare some basic survival tools, right?
"Well, I probably don't have a camera, but my camera can take pictures for you... What kind of pictures do you want to take? Is it right here?"
Looking at the wastebasket-like robot in the corner, Chu Guang sighed and said.
"There's no point in taking photos here...forget it, I'll figure it out myself."
We can't catch the alien species here.
However, it might be worth considering taking Xiaoqi outside.
Most alien species are not interested in inedible iron lumps. They can be disguised and stuck on the roof of the building, which is simply a housekeeping artifact!
The more Chu Guang thought about it, the more reliable it became.
Board the Penguin via the computer in the residents' lobby.
Chu Guang found that four players had sent him private messages, asking him which company he worked for, what fully immersive gaming meant, and what the gaming helmet was all about.
To be honest, Chu Guang didn't know how to answer their questions, and it was impossible to tell them the true situation of the world.
Only let them believe that this is a game world.
Only then can they come as the "Fourth Natural Disaster", be fearless and hardworking, and become his strongest tools.
"Master."
"What's wrong?"
Looking at Chu Guang who turned off his computer and stood up from his chair, Xiao Qi, who was squatting in the corner, asked curiously.
"Don't you have to reply to their messages?"
"That's not necessary."
The more explanations there are, the more holes there will be. It is better to fool them by saying corporate secrets or state secrets.
As for the rest?
Let them guess for themselves.
Otherwise, what is the purpose of having a long head?
Isn't it just for brainstorming?
